long-post-splitter/features/numbering: Automatic segment numbering (1/N, 2/N, ...) for thread posting
long-post-splitter/features/split_modes: Four split modes: paragraph, sentence, word, and character boundaries
long-post-splitter/features/weighted_cou: X.com weighted character counting: CJK and emojis count as 2, URLs count as 23
long-post-splitter/how_to_use/step1: Paste or type your long text in the input area.
long-post-splitter/how_to_use/step2: Select the character limit: 280 for X.com posts, or set a custom value for other platforms.
long-post-splitter/how_to_use/step3: Choose a split mode: paragraph preserves structure, sentence breaks at sentence boundaries, word splits at word boundaries.
long-post-splitter/how_to_use/step4: Choose a numbering format (1/N or (1/N)) and optional line break for thread posting.
long-post-splitter/how_to_use/step5: Click Split and copy each segment to post as a thread.
long-post-splitter/note: Split long text into segments that fit X.com (Twitter) and other social media character limits, with weighted counting for CJK, emojis, and URLs.
long-post-splitter/tags: long post, split, thread, x.com, twitter, character limit, text splitter
